title: A 40-Ton Humpback Whale Launches Itself Out of the Ocean

scenes.text: A 40-ton whale can launch itself out of the ocean.
A humpback weighs around 40 tons, and it throws most of its body into the air.
Then it crashes back down onto its side or back.
Scientists aren't sure why. Ideas include talking across miles of ocean, shaking off parasites, or just play.

description:
A 40-ton whale can launch itself out of the ocean.
A humpback breach throws most of a 40-ton body into the air before it crashes back down. Nobody knows exactly why they do it.
